notes: New: Radio now has a way to report a problem (Settings > Radio > Report a problem) - files it as a GitHub report with basic app/device info attached automatically. Improved: play/pause and buffering now cross-fade instead of cutting instantly, the favorite heart pops on tap, and lists that reorder or filter (Local Music, filter chips, recent searches) now animate instead of snapping. Fixed a duplicate visualizer animation running unseen behind the expanded Now Playing screen.
